post.description: Validates the config, stores a PENDING run and enqueues the job. With an Idempotency-Key that the user already used for the same config, returns that run instead of starting a new one.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key that makes the start safe to retry. A repeated request with the same key and the same config returns the run created by the first one instead of starting a new run; the same key with a different config is rejected with 422. Keys are scoped per user. Omit it to always start a new run.

201.description: The test run was created and enqueued, or the run previously started with the same Idempotency-Key

422.description: This idempotency key was already used for a different test config

error.message: This idempotency key was already used for a different test config

503.description: Too many test runs are in progress, or the test job could not be enqueued

error.message: Too many test runs are in progress, or the test job could not be enqueued

get.description: Returns the run history, newest first, with cursor pagination. Each item is a short row: status, timestamps and failure reason; single runs add the tested request, targetRps, durationSeconds and the response time p95Ms; scenario runs add stepsCount and okCount. Secret URL query parameter values are masked. Configs and results are never included: load them with GET /v1/test-runs/:id.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

get.description: Returns the run details: status, timestamps, failure reason, the stored config and the typed final result whose shape follows the run type. Secret header values and URL query parameter values are masked in the config and in the result URLs.

post.description: Starts a new run with the stored config of the given run, whatever its status: stores a PENDING run and enqueues the job. With an Idempotency-Key that the user already used for the same config, returns that run instead of starting a new one.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key that makes the start safe to retry. A repeated request with the same key and the same config returns the run created by the first one instead of starting a new run; the same key with a different config is rejected with 422. Keys are scoped per user. Omit it to always start a new run.

201.description: The new test run was created and enqueued, or the run previously started with the same Idempotency-Key

post.description: Requests a stop and returns the current status. The status becomes STOPPED once the worker reports the run as finished.

get.description: Server-sent events. 'status' carries { status, reason? }: the current status right after connecting, then every change. 'snapshot' carries the per-second metrics of the run. The stream closes when the run reaches a final status.

get.description: Returns the OAuth providers configured on the server. Public.

post.description: Validates an OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 document given as YAML or JSON text, resolves internal $ref values, normalizes it into servers and endpoints and stores it for the current user. External references are never resolved. The source text is never returned.

put.description: Validates and normalizes a new OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 document with the same rules as import and replaces the stored document, servers and endpoints. The id and import time stay the same; the display name changes only when given. On any error nothing is saved and the previous version stays. Returns the spec with a summary of added, changed and removed endpoints; an endpoint counts as changed when its parameters, request body or responses differ. The source text is never returned.
